blocks.text: Admirers of modern science boast that man's cleverness will find ways to sustain any number of people by using to the fullest every inch of space. But even now we are victims of many science solutions that cause more problems than they solve. Science does not always have the answer at the precise time when it is needed.

readingSentences.korean: 현대 과학의 찬미자들은 인간의 영리함이 공간의 모든 구석을 최대한 활용하여 얼마든지 많은 인구를 부양할 방법을 찾아낼 것이라고 자랑한다.
